descriptions.preferred: 由 Karan Junker 从嘉年华的幼苗中发现的，叶子和嘉年华有点相似，比嘉年华会更耐晒一些，夏季仍需要适当遮阴。如果说嘉年华适合众众赏共评，那么银色庆典更适合独自寻味，嘉年华从远处看一树雪白，犹如亭亭少女，而银色庆典造物主挥毫描绘出它细致的纹理，需要靠近才能看到它的锦叶。春天，新芽和嫩叶略带粉红色，随着时间的推移逐渐褪色，变成绿底边缘乳白色的叶子，白色边缘较窄。 5 裂叶，成年树高约 6m ，长势很好，通常枝条长得很浓密。

rhs.description: Deciduous, round-headed tree about 7m tall, an offspring of 'Carnival' with mid to dark green, 5-lobed leaves edged creamy-white, that are said to be sun-scorch resistant and turn rich yellow in autumn. Bears clusters of green flowers in spring followed by greenish winged fruits that age to red in autumn

attributes.suggested_uses: Architectural, City/Courtyard Gardens, , Cottage/Informal Garden, Coastal, Wildlife Gardens

care.cultivation: Grow in fertile, moist but well-drained soil in sun or light shade. Suitable for chalky soils. See tree cultivation for further advice
care.pruning: Pruning group 1 , if necessary, from late autumn to midwinter only
care.propagation: Propagate by grafting in late winter or softwood cuttings in early summer

resistance.pest: May be susceptible to gall mites , aphids , caterpillars and horse chestnut scale
resistance.disease: May be susceptible to tar spot , verticillium wilt and honey fungus

rhs_zh.description: 落叶、圆头形小乔木，高约 7 米，为 ‘Carnival’ 的后代。叶片中绿至深绿，5 裂，边缘具乳白色镶边，据称较耐日灼，秋季转为浓黄色。春季开成簇绿色花，随后结绿色翅果，至秋季成熟转红。

attributes.suggested_uses: 造景型，城市/庭院花园，乡村/自然式花园，滨海花园，野生动物友好花园

care.cultivation: 宜栽培于肥沃、湿润但排水良好的土壤中，可处于全日照或疏荫环境。适合石灰质土壤。更多建议请参见树木栽培说明。
care.pruning: 修剪组 1；如有需要，仅可在深秋至仲冬期间修剪。
care.propagation: 可于冬末采用嫁接繁殖，或于初夏进行软枝扦插繁殖。

resistance.pest: 可能易受瘿螨、蚜虫、毛虫和七叶树盾蚧危害
resistance.disease: 可能易感焦油斑病、黄萎病和蜜环菌根腐病
